cursor_cloud_task_catalog.claim: Cursor Cloud Agent Task catalogs stayed built-in-only for Kaola custom types. A consumer with 14 git-tracked project profiles still exposed generalPurpose, explore, cursor-guide, bugbot, security-review, and best-of-n-runner; omit-model and inherit generalPurpose succeeded; cursor-grok-4.6-high was resolver-rejected. A later producer Cloud parent also lacked Kaola names and additionally exposed explore, computerUse, and videoReview.

cursor_cli_named_profile_20260827.claim: Authenticated standalone Cursor CLI build 2026.08.25-3e8eec8 discovered an explicit project materialization and dispatched the exact custom implementer type. The parent omitted a model override; the Task carrier resolved cursor-grok-4.6-medium and the child returned the requested read-only probe token.

cursor_app_local_named_profile_20260827.claim: Cursor App 3.17.21 local IDE Agent exposed all 14 project Kaola types and successfully dispatched exact implementer without repository mutation. The UI did not expose the selected child model, effort, or profile-source carrier.

cursor_cloud_preboot_catalog_20260827.claim: Negative control: a brand-new App-started Cloud chat selected branch probe/cursor-cloud-1041-20260827a at commit ead40c2741f4cae7e0a0cb473bba8a8a4a80c7a6, where all 14 project Cursor profiles were committed before boot. Its live Task enum remained built-in-only: generalPurpose, explore, computerUse, videoReview, cursor-guide, bugbot, security-review, and best-of-n-runner; exact implementer was absent and no substitute was dispatched. This proves project files are not the Cloud carrier, not that Cloud lacks named roles.

cursor_cloud_saved_environment_20260827.claim: Positive control: Cursor dashboard environment 9116f5fb-a1f4-11f1-b532-320a589b8025 saved the remote install script ./install-cursor.sh --global --yes --forge=github. Build bld-20260827-aaac14bf-e980-4d1a-9600-e8b3fb2e031e installed all 14 profiles under /home/ubuntu/.cursor/agents, snapshotted, and warmed. Fresh Cloud parent bc-f2f0f15f-31d9-416a-9952-35243def5561 then exposed all 14 Kaola names in its 23-type live Task catalog; exact implementer child bc-63c79c19-f9fb-5892-970e-bb1606ad1a3b returned PROBE_OK_CURSOR_CLOUD_SAVED_ENV_IMPLEMENTER with no substitute or per-call model override. Child model and profile-source carriers remained unobservable.

delegation_guidance.profile_lookup: Find named profiles in project `.claude/agents/`, user `~/.claude/agents/`, plugin `agents/`, managed settings, or the current session's `--agents`; managed/session/project/user/plugin precedence remains Claude-owned, and the Kaola installer uses the user directory by default.
delegation_guidance.dispatch_carrier: Dispatch with `Agent` and `subagent_type: "<role>"`; installed Kaola profiles use `model: inherit`, so pass the role tier's model on the call when preserving its default tier.

tiers.standard: standard → `sonnet`; effort is not pinned and uses the runtime's default effort
tiers.reasoning: reasoning → `opus`; effort is not pinned and uses the runtime's default effort
tiers.heavy: heavy → `fable`; effort is not pinned and uses the runtime's default effort

delegation_guidance.availability: Inspect the current Agent/Task type catalog and effective precedence. Claude currently permits recursive subagents to its native depth limit, which can be configured by the host; do not infer total child unavailability from one missing custom name.

delegation_guidance.dispatch_carrier: Dispatch with the `task` tool and `subagent_type: "<role>"`; the task call has no per-call model or effort field.

tiers.standard: standard → session model and session effort, unless the user configured the optional standard model pin
tiers.reasoning: reasoning → the per-role override list when configured, otherwise session model and session effort
tiers.heavy: heavy → classifies as reasoning for that optional per-role override, otherwise session model and session effort

delegation_guidance.tool_boundary: Native profile permission denials carry the role's edit, shell, and web capability boundary.
delegation_guidance.native_routes: Native alternatives include broad `general`, read-only local `explore`, and read-only external-research `scout`; direct `@name` invocation, `task_id` resume, and experimental background work remain runtime-owned options.
delegation_guidance.availability: Read the current task type catalog, permissions, and user configuration. OpenCode defaults to one child depth unless the user raises it; inherited session settings and optional pins remain user-owned capabilities.

delegation_guidance.profile_lookup: Find native profiles in project `.kimi-code/agents/` or `.agents/agents/`, or in `$KIMI_CODE_HOME/agents/` / `~/.agents/agents/`; Kaola role names use `kaola-role-<role>`.
delegation_guidance.dispatch_carrier: Dispatch with `Agent` or `AgentSwarm` and `subagent_type: "kaola-role-<role>"`; Agent supports resume/background, while AgentSwarm exposes up to 128 parallel items.

tiers.standard: standard → session inherit for model and thinking
tiers.reasoning: reasoning → session inherit for model and thinking
tiers.heavy: heavy → session inherit for model and thinking

delegation_guidance.tool_boundary: The named profile's native `tools` allowlist carries the role tool boundary.
delegation_guidance.native_routes: Native alternatives are full writable `coder`, read-only `explore`, and non-shell `plan`, plus custom Agent or AgentSwarm routes; use each under its actual boundary.
delegation_guidance.availability: Honor native project/user precedence and the current Agent catalog. Ordinary profiles ignore model fields and inherit session model plus effort; the optional experimental secondary-model pool is user-owned. Built-ins are leaves, while custom profiles may allowlist deeper subagents.

delegation_guidance.profile_lookup: Find named profiles in the project `.grok/agents/` directory or the user `~/.grok/agents/` directory.
delegation_guidance.dispatch_carrier: Dispatch with `spawn_subagent` and `subagent_type: "<role>"`; preserve native background, isolation, resume, cwd, and optional per-call model choices, but omit per-call effort because the profile carries it.

tiers.standard: standard → inherit the session model with profile effort `medium`
tiers.reasoning: reasoning → inherit the session model with profile effort `high`
tiers.heavy: heavy → inherit the session model with profile effort `xhigh`

delegation_guidance.tool_boundary: The named profile's native `tools` allowlist carries the role tool boundary.
delegation_guidance.native_routes: Native alternatives include full `general-purpose`, read/shell `explore`, and read/shell `plan`, plus background and isolated children; use the closest truthful contract.
delegation_guidance.availability: Respect the current `spawn_subagent` catalog and its native options. Grok children cannot spawn descendants, but Kaola does not narrow the root runtime's capabilities.

delegation_guidance.profile_lookup: Find custom profiles in project `.cursor/agents/` or user `~/.cursor/agents/`; a generated file at a documented path is not discovery proof. `--global` writes only the selected host's user carrier and does not write an ambient Git repository. Project materialization is explicit `--target DIR`. The standalone CLI requires project materialization on the measured local host; workflow-next/finalize may call the installed safe helper with explicit `$PWD` immediately before a CLI/local named dispatch. The helper derives only from the receipt-verified global authority and fails closed on missing/stale authority, collision, symlink, or modified ownership. Cursor App local IDE and App-started Cloud are different execution hosts and never inherit that CLI materialization rule. Cloud uses its own dashboard-managed remote user home. During agent-led setup, configure the same `--global` installer there, test a Build, report its exact ID and assertions, and ask the user to click Save; a draft Build is not persisted. Start from that Build's details page or verify the fresh Agent's visible Build link matches before continuing, because a generic New Agent entry may resolve another personal environment for the repository.
delegation_guidance.dispatch_carrier: Select a custom agent explicitly as `/<role>` or by natural-language routing and use the live `Task` schema. Inspect that schema's type enum first. When it contains a Kaola role name, dispatch that name and omit a requested per-call model only when the named profile can resolve its tier pin. The supported CLI stream materialized a named call as `subagentType.custom.name` and `generalPurpose` as `subagentType.unspecified`; do not invent unpublished request fields. When the live enum is built-in-only, omit-model is the parent, not a profile pin, and a resolver-listed model slug from the live schema is an effort lever. On Cloud, committed project profiles alone are a negative control; install globally inside the dashboard-managed remote environment, have the user save it, and open a fresh parent whose visible Build identity matches the tested Build before treating a still-missing name as a capability gap.
delegation_guidance.tool_boundary: The named profile's native `readonly` flag carries its write boundary.
delegation_guidance.native_routes: Inspect the live Task catalog. The supported CLI exposed writable `generalPurpose` plus `cursor-guide`, `bugbot`, `security-review`, and `best-of-n-runner`; other Cursor hosts document scoped `Explore`, `Bash`, and `Browser`. A Cloud negative control exposed `explore` and stayed built-in-only before the remote environment was installed and saved; the corrected saved environment exposed all 14 Kaola types. Use only a route this host actually reports and under its real capability and identity.
delegation_guidance.fallback_search: If the exact named role is unavailable, inspect the currently reported `generalPurpose`, built-in, and other native child routes for the current item and use each only as itself. First distinguish an uninstalled or unsaved host carrier from a runtime capability gap. A custody-bearing miss after the correct host installation inlines that item with a specific capability_gap; do not convert one miss into a run-wide inline policy.
delegation_guidance.availability: The current Task catalog is authoritative. Authenticated standalone CLI build 2026.08.25-3e8eec8 proved explicit project custom implementer dispatch and the raw Task carrier resolved cursor-grok-4.6-medium when the parent omitted a model override. Cursor App 3.17.21 local IDE separately proved all 14 project Kaola types plus exact implementer dispatch, but did not expose the child model/profile carrier. Cursor Cloud separately proved all 14 Kaola names plus exact implementer after the same global installer ran inside a dashboard-managed remote environment, the user saved and snapshotted it, and a fresh Cloud parent started from that build; committed project profiles alone were not the Cloud carrier. Cloud child model/profile source remained unobservable. Explicit or automatic selection and resume by agent ID remain runtime-owned options. Reopening the CLI process with the same chat discovered an added project profile, while same-process hot load remains unknown. Product surfaces and App local/Cloud hosts remain independent. `--global` does not write an ambient Git repository.

delegation_guidance.profile_lookup: Find the runtime-loaded user-scope profile in `${ZCODE_HOME:-~/.zcode}/agents/`; project `.zcode/agents/` is staging that the installer syncs to user scope.
delegation_guidance.dispatch_carrier: Use automatic selection or native `@<role>` dispatch; if this session exposes an `Agent` call with `subagent_type`, follow that live schema rather than inventing unpublished fields, and omit a per-call model because the profile carries it.
delegation_guidance.tool_boundary: The named profile's native `tools` allowlist carries the role tool boundary.
delegation_guidance.native_routes: Native alternatives include full `general-purpose` and read-only `Explore`, reached through automatic selection or `@`; foreground/background choice remains runtime-owned.
delegation_guidance.availability: Profiles are user-scope and load on the next session; project `.zcode/agents/` is only installer staging. Subagents cannot spawn children, but the root runtime's other native routes remain available.
